dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Stalled have I the inexorable march of time and veiled the omnipresent gaze of fate.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Traveler from beyond, the sovereign Prinzessin shall arbitrate the discord of thine heart!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: What mein Fräulein means is that she happens to be free right now.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: If there is something on your mind, she is happy to listen.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Actually, I want to know if anything is bothering you, Fischl.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Preposterous! I am the Prinzessin der Verurteilung! What mortal follies could venture to imprint themselves upon my psyche?

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: When I was out on reconnaissance, didn't the new recruits from the Adventurers' Guild joke about you since they couldn't understand what you were saying?

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: I remember that you were distressed about this, mein Fräulein.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Nonsense! How could I be perturbed by such trifling antics from my retinue?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Alas, I lament that those neophytes lack semblance to you, traveler from an outer world, the one delivered before me by the threads of fate.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: The one who perceives the truth and meaning of my declarations.

choices.text: You offer a surfeit of praise.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Yes, indeed do I perceive rightly...

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: By my regard, should Oz be conducting reconnaissance on my behalf, I grant you permission to remain in my propinquity.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Now, relay the will of the Prinzessin to her attendants!

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: Frankly, I also think this is a good idea.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What if my understanding is off?

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Allay all doubt, for you are the one that I, the Prinzessin, have personally appointed. Hesitate not and proclaim my decrees to this world's denizens!

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Rejoice! That wanton brume of devilry hath dissipated beneath my immaculate radiance!

choices.text: I am honored to understand you.
